# T-6: Wire skill-rule expansion + marker strip into the skill deploy pipeline

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Deployed SKILL.md contains rule bodies inline and no data-directive markers.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Pipeline runs include resolution → skill-rule expansion → marker strip → write.
- Public surface (functions called by setup / upgrade) keeps its existing call shape.
- Unknown id propagates as a build failure with non-zero exit.

## Implementation Notes
Integration is into `src/lib/skills.js` `deploySkillsFromDir`. Avoids the existing tolerant resolver to preserve fail-fast behavior.

## Test Strategy
Integration test that runs the deploy pipeline against a fixture with valid and invalid (unknown id) source content.
